note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — nothing parses or executes this file. The `command` strings below illustrate intent; they are shell-quoted templates and MUST NOT be fed to a shell as-is (an agent-controlled file path would be an injection vector). scripts/dispatch.js is the real executor, wired in ../settings.json, and it spawns checks with an argv array and no shell. Documents the UNIVERSAL, stack-independent ruleset. scripts/dispatch.js is the executor (wired in ../settings.json) — it runs the secret scan below on every Write/Edit plus any checks contributed by stack overlay fragments in ./stacks/<stack>.json. This file is documentation of that ruleset; dispatch.js does not parse it at runtime.

hooks.name: Check for Hardcoded Secrets
hooks.description: Prevent committing hardcoded secrets, API keys, passwords, or connection strings. Universal — runs on every file, every stack. PreToolUse blocks the write before it lands on disk; PostToolUse feeds findings back to the agent.

hooks.name: Worktree Guard
hooks.description: Feature work belongs in its own git worktree on a feature branch, never in the shared main checkout where concurrent agent sessions overwrite each other's uncommitted work. Warns once per session (PostToolUse feedback, never blocks) when a source file is written in the MAIN checkout while HEAD is a default branch. Universal — runs on every stack.
